name: Mukat Pipes Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Mukat Pipes Ltd manufactures and sells Longitudinal & Helical Pipes[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MPL is a part of the Mukat Group. It is an ISO- 9001-2015 certified company manufactures Large Diameter Submerged Arc Welded (SAW) M.S. Pipes both Longitudinal & Spiral process in the Diameter range of 12 inches to 100 inches and wall thickness up to 20 mm conforming to IS-3589-2001.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.99% over past five years.
